title: Final Lifetime
description: Essential Criteria: The correct lifetime of the rho meson in the laboratory frame must be calculated and stated.

title: Final Decay Distance
description: Essential Criteria: The mean decay distance for the rho meson must be accurately computed and presented.

title: Threshold Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The threshold energy for producing rho mesons must be correctly derived and reported.

title: Average Production
description: Essential Criteria: The average number of rho mesons produced must be calculated correctly based on the given parameters.

title: Opening Angle
description: Essential Criteria: The minimum opening angle between the outgoing pions must be determined and stated correctly.

title: Lorentz Factor Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the Lorentz factor for the rho meson must be shown and correctly applied.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The application of energy conservation principles in the threshold energy calculation must be demonstrated.

title: Density Usage
description: Important Criteria: The use of the density of liquid hydrogen in the average production calculation must be correctly applied.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes in energy or momentum calculations must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: All units must be consistent and correctly converted where necessary throughout the calculations.
